announcement.title: One-flow setup, new AI models and Windows fixes
announcement.description:
Fixes: On Windows, Claude installed with npm now starts chats. Connecting Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini now keeps going if Halofy’s connection drops for a moment.

Improvements: New installs sign in first and get set up in one flow: connect your AI subscription and meet your General agent. If a computer has no git, Halofy sets up its own. GPT-6.2 Astra, GPT-6.2 Sol and Gemini 4 Neon are available on ChatGPT and Google plans that include them.

Known issues: If Halofy installed ChatGPT for you before this update, sign in to ChatGPT again to get GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol. Windows installers remain unsigned.
